US House Advances Russia Sanctions Bill With Potential Tariffs on India

The U.S. House of Representatives has advanced a bill aimed at sanctioning Russia, which includes provisions that could impose 100% tariffs on countries like India that purchase Russian oil and gas. The resolution passed by a 214-211 vote, moving the legislation closer to a final vote expected on September 16. While the bill grants the U.S. President the authority to enact these tariffs, it is not yet certain that tariffs will be imposed on India. The advancement of the bill reportedly surprised House Democratic leadership.
